payload.feature:
LANDING PR for story #351, slice 3 (asks 2 and 7, both ruled by the operator on 2026-10-10): a run's scope is decided once, in brokkr-view, and served. The terminal's rule leads: Scope, Lens, lens_for and keeps_* move from the CLI's render.rs into brokkr-view/src/scope.rs, and RunView.scopes serves each phase's and each participant's membership (phases, participant keys, journal row seqs), so the TUI, `inspect` and ui.html paint one answer. In the browser, a seat drill now narrows the trail to that seat's phases' rows; "show all" clears as before. /api/run/<id> is retired. This is #351's last slice; merging it closes #351.

The branch story-351-slice-3 ends at d2f77f77, a clean merge of main f00780a0, over two commits off main c9a205e1 from story run implement-story-351-slice-3-deri-93c5ff72 (two implement rounds; the first review returned residual at medium, the second ruled residual at low):
- f454cb7d: the scope moves into the view and is served; the browser paints the terminal's rule; /api/run is retired.
- b211cc0b: a scope miss folds participants after the terminal sanitizes each name; the browser looks a scope's rows up once per render.

The PR's Ruling line cites the operator's two rulings (the TUI leads; retire /api/run) and asks the operator to accept brokkr-view's public API growth (quality/public-api/brokkr-view.txt 490 -> 517) and VIEW_VERSION 17 -> 18 for the served RunView.scopes.

Every review position, panel member or chief, is READ-ONLY: it changes no tracked file and makes no commit, whatever this text asks below. It reports each finding. Only the implement phase fixes a finding the review returns.

Judge:
1. That the predicates moved without change: the same membership for a phase scope and a seat scope over every fixture run, the two error texts byte for byte, and no surface (render.rs, the TUI, `inspect`, ui.html) restating a scope rule.
2. That the browser's served membership equals what `inspect --seat` prints for the same run, and that the browser's only behaviour change is the ruled one (a seat drill narrows the trail).
3. That /api/run/<id> is gone with its handler and tests, that an unknown path keeps its exact 404, and that no living doc names it (records are not edited).
4. That VIEW_VERSION 18 is the right move under the view contract (#376 and decision 0076 item 9 are the precedents), and that the view stays pure (layering::scan).
5. That the merge of main f00780a0 changes neither side.
6. That the carried items are listed for the PR: no proposed decision document accompanies the change (the operator's rulings on #351 are recorded); RunView.scopes is precomputed on every run_view (cost, a follow-up); ui.html does not guard a selectedPhase the view no longer serves (unreachable today).

This run lands one pull request under decision 0051, so the contribution gate can vouch for it.

For the implement phase only: if a finding returns the branch, fix exactly that finding and prove it with a test bound by a compiling mutation. Then run, all clean: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy on the crates you touched, with -D warnings; typos --hidden; quality/ratchet.sh files, clones and api. Do not touch cli_args.rs, broker.rs, broker/*, secret*, hands/namespace/entry.rs, observer.rs, agents/mcp.rs or bundle/mcp.rs (another session's).

Commit one signed-off commit ending "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>", and never push. Do not run scripts/coverage-exact.sh; the controller runs it. Run every command in the foreground: never background a command or schedule a wakeup, because a headless seat ends when it waits.

Threat model (operator ruling, 2026-09-26): catch realistic accidental misuse, and fail closed on what cannot be read.

On the contrary, recipes/research-dsh/README.md records that since dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 the headless profile ships web-fetch-http with page fetch on and a keyed search, so native egress is likely present and no OFF control for it has been declared or measured. Findings, all to carry in the PR:
1. LOW: openspec/specs/transcript-reading/spec.md:1670 still names /api/run/<run> among the browser read surfaces. This is a living specification, not an archived record (status_pages::is_record likewise treats openspec/specs as living). The handler and its old tests were retired correctly, but the task's requirement that no living doc names the retired route is incomplete. Remove that route from the living scenario; preserve records.
2. LOW: no proposed decision document accompanies the semantic browser change, route retirement and served model growth, although docs/house-rules.md:2-3 requires one. Carry the implementer's stated reason: the operator ruled both asks on #351 on 2026-10-10, and the framing asks for API/version acceptance through the PR's Ruling line under the #376/0076 precedent. The operator's acceptance is still the PR handoff; review adds no approval flow.
3. INFO, carried cost follow-up (0071 rulings 4/7): scope.rs:230 precomputes every phase's and participant's membership on every run_view, including terminal consumers; derivation and payload grow with scopes times journal rows. This is the explicitly admitted precomputed-membership choice.
4. INFO, carried unreachable case (0071 ruling 9): ui.html:1214 does not guard selectedPhase when its served membership is absent, and the falsy scope would show the whole run under a phase chip. Unreachable today: phases are append-only and select() resets selectedPhase on a run switch. The vanished-participant guard is present.

Confirmed: the moved membership predicates preserve the previous render.rs rule; phase, label/key seat, repeated-seat and phase-less-seat cases have exact tests. scope_refusal now sanitizes each name and folds adjacent participants afterward, preserving the former error bytes. render, inspect and the TUI call the view; ui.html consumes served membership, with its old predicates removed. A seat drill continues into its phases' trail, show-all clears both selections as before, and the set of kept rows is built once before the loop. Served membership is compared with inspect's graph, seats and trail for the same run. /api/run handler is absent, retired-route 404 body is pinned exactly, and unknown-path handling is unchanged. VIEW_VERSION 18 follows lib.rs's additive-wire-field contract; the public API baseline is 490 -> 517 lines. Layering gates confirm view purity (0071 rulings 1/7). Both merge directions have identical stable patch IDs to their respective pre-merge deltas, and the combined merge diff is empty: neither side changed.
